title: Xyrxzy's Subversion
problem: Its text says "after this creature manually casts a spell". The code puts it in the on-cast list, which runs after every cast, manual or automatic, and has no manual check at all. It then casts 3 random spells taken from random enemies' gems, as automatic casts, right away. Each of those casts runs the on-cast list again, so Subversion fires again, and so on. The chain stops only when the creature hits its per-turn cast limit (14 casts). It also fires from artifact / Nether Stone / other automatic casts. Not blacklisted (id 1359; a Nether Boss trait sold in the Nether Shop).
notes: In-game test: Xyrxzy's Subversion: cast one spell manually; the effect fires once, not again from its own automatic casts. Community claim: Doesn't respect "manually" and re-triggers itself until the action limit. Evidence: bc_OnCast L537–L548 @0x141454fd0: scr_CritHasPassive(caster, 1274) → bc_GetEnemiesOf → loop i <= 3 (0x1402bd5d0 @0x1414550d0) → random enemy → bc_GetSpellGems → random gem → bc_CreatureCastSpellGem(caster, gem, 1) @0x1414552cd (automatic, runs inline). bc_OnCast is called for every execution with no arg3 gate (bc_CreatureCast L19802–L19803 @0x140a8ed22). Cast limit casts >= limit in bc_CreatureCast L42–L59.. Fix sketch: Preferred: make it fire only after manual casts. bc_OnCast doesn't receive the manual flag, so this needs new code: e.g. a global "current cast is manual" flag set in bc_CreatureCast before L19802 and tested in the L537 block (H). Cheaper alternative: text fix "After this creature casts a spell (manual or automatic)…" (T), which still leaves the self-loop. Triage 2026-10-26: Fires after every cast (no manual check) and re-triggers itself on its own automatic casts until the cast limit. Hook: gate on the manual-cast flag of the triggering cast.

release_notes.intended: After the holder manually casts a spell, it also casts 3 random enemies' spells.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it triggered after every cast, including the 3 spells it cast itself, chaining until the creature hit its cast limit.
release_notes.fix: Now it only triggers after the holder's manual casts, so it can't chain itself.
